package application

import (
	"context"

	. "metaldocs/internal/modules/iam/domain"
)

// A3.3 negative fixture (Rule 3, dot import of the LOW-LEVEL package): the
// escape hatch that makes the other two rules blind.
//
// Rules 1 and 2 both ask the same question — "which import path is behind this
// qualifier?" A dot import removes the qualifier. `UserIDFromContext(ctx)` below
// is the banned accessor, but syntactically it is a bare identifier that could
// name anything in file scope, and deciding otherwise would take type
// information the guard deliberately does not build.
//
// So the ImportSpec is refused instead. That is the smaller property and the
// stronger one: there is nothing to infer, because the shape the inference would
// have to reason about cannot be written in the first place.
//
// See scripts/testdata/guard-fixtures/README.md.
func chargeDotted(ctx context.Context) string {
	return UserIDFromContext(ctx)
}
